- Goal: integrate Redwood Inference for live assistant + batch embeddings for knowledge graph sync.
- Rough monthly token expectation you mentioned on the call: please confirm ballpark of both inference (generation) and embedding tokens.
- Target unit economics: you said you were aiming for a target $/1M tokens; can you share the target range you’re budgeting for (ballpark is fine).
- Timeline: pilot in Nov, production H1 next year.
- Discounts: you asked about startup credits and committed-use pricing — please confirm which of those you want us to prioritize in a proposal (startup credit + 6/12/24mo commit).

If you can reply with: 1) monthly token range, 2) target $/1M tokens, 3) procurement lead/contact, I’ll put together a simple quote and an example committed-use schedule. Attaching a one-sheet you can fill for estimated per-feature token splits.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Pricing/Programs once we have your numbers.

Best,

Thanks — very helpful details. I pulled together two concrete options so you have apples-to-apples numbers to share with Procurement/CFO:  

Option A — Startup + short commit (pilot friendly)
- Startup founder credit: $30,000 in credits applied over first 90 days (applies to compute token charges only).
- No minimum commit required.
- Effective pilot pricing example at 12M gen tokens/month (after credits): ~ $3,900/$1M for months 1–3, then list rates apply.

Option B — Committed-use (12 months)
- 12mo committed spend banding: 0–0.5B tokens: 10% off list; 0.5B–1.5B: 18% off; >1.5B: 25% off (discounts apply to token unit price).
- Example: at 15M gen tokens/mo => annualized ~180M tokens -> falls in 0.5B–1.5B band -> ~18% off list -> effective ~$4,000/$1M (illustrative).

Option C — Multi-year (2-year match)
- 24mo commit with staged rebate: additional 5% rebate in year 2 if volume growth >20% YoY.
- Reserved slot priority and SLA uplift for Dedicated capacity available as an add-on.

Next steps I recommend: 1) confirm whether you want us to price against Option A (pilot-first) or Option B/C (commit), and 2) confirm whether the startup credit authorization should be fast-tracked (I can request Sales Ops pre-approval).

I’m copying Marissa (Programs) to confirm the founder credit eligibility checklist and Ben (solution engineer) to make sure the SOW covers data residency. If you’re good, I’ll produce a short quote + SOW draft for signature.

Thanks,
Jonas
